0.long_answer: Among the different types of pneumoconiosis, asbestosis is the form that may lead to mesothelioma. Asbestosis results from inhaling asbestos fibers, which not only cause scarring and fibrosis in the lungs but also significantly increase the risk of developing mesothelioma—a malignant tumor of the mesothelium, typically affecting the pleura. Prolonged or high-level exposure to asbestos is a well-documented cause of both diseases, and medical research has established a strong link between asbestos exposure and mesothelioma.
